goal: When each agent reply ends, record the context the agent considered during that turn (the new slice of the session log: prompt, injected instructions, tool inputs and results, replies, token counts) as audit events linked to the stored prompt, behind an off-by-default switch.
constraints: New switch workflow_context, default false, requires Workflow; mirrors workflow_prompts (re-read on every hook, turning it off stops capture and discards queued records, stored history stays).
Capture at the Stop hook (turn end) for both Claude Code and Codex: read the session log from the byte offset saved in the session state, never the whole file, and save the new offset.
Each record carries the prompt_id of the turn's prompt, the entry's role and kind, its text in 2000-byte UTF-8 chunks, and the turn's token counts.
Pass text through the existing redact(); drop base64 images; cap any single entry at a fixed size and record its full byte length and SHA-256 when cut.
Hooks stay fail-open and within their timeout; a missing or unreadable session log records nothing and does not block the turn.

non_goals.description: No API recording proxy; hidden system instructions and tool definitions are not captured in this task.
Do not change the phase guard, denylist, or failure budget.
No changes to Jev routing or the signals service.

acceptance.criterion: A Stop hook with the switch on emits context records for only the log entries added since the previous turn, linked to that turn's prompt_id
With workflow_context off (the default) no context record is emitted or queued
The existing workflow audit tests still pass
The audit service builds, accepts the new event, and the Workflow page lists a turn's context under its prompt
docs/setup.md documents the workflow_context switch and what is and is not captured
